title: Forklift Operation Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Forklift Operation Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
html:
Project Information

FORKLIFT TYPE: ☐ Counterbalance ☐ Reach ☐ Pallet Jack CAPACITY: ______________ lbs

OPERATOR: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ LOAD TYPE: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Pre-Oper. Inspection-Fluid leaks
-Damaged tires
-Broken lights
-Malfunctioning brakes		-Fire
-Tip over
-Struck pedestrian		12 (HIGH)-Check fluid levels
-Inspect tires/pressure
-Test horn, lights, backup alarm
-Check forks for damage
-Test brakes
2. Mounting & Startup-Slips/trips
-Sudden motion
-Seat belt not used		-Falls
-Crush injuries		6 (MEDIUM)-Use three-point contact
-Adjust seat and mirrors
-Fasten seat belt
-Start only while seated
3. Travel (Loaded)-Collision
-Tip over
-Pedestrians
-Overhead obstructions		-Struck pedestrian
-Crush injuries
-Struck by		20 (VERY HIGH)-Observe speed limits
-Keep load low (4-6" off ground)
-Look in direction of travel
-Sound horn at intersections
-Watch for overhead clearance
4. Loading & Stacking-Unstable load
-Exceed capacity
-Poor stacking
-Elevated operator		-Load fall
-Tip over
-Crush injuries		15 (HIGH)-Center load on forks
-Tilt mast back
-Check load capacity plate
-Stack evenly and securely
-Use spotter for blind areas
-Never stand under load
5. Parking & Shutdown-Rollaway
-Inadvertent startup
-Blocking egress		-Runaway
-Collision
-Struck pedestrian		10 (MEDIUM)-Park on level surface
-Lower forks fully
-Apply parking brake
-Remove key
-Block wheels on incline

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ High-Vis Vest ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves

☐ Seat Belt (must be worn)
